title: BixRouter
excerpt: A web app that turns AI conversations into branching DAGs
content_html:
Chats that match the way you think

Click + below any response to branch your conversation in a new direction.

Select text in any response and right-click to quote or define it in a new branch.

Use the panel on the right edge to switch models, response style, or dark mode.

Save your chats as compressed .bixroute files, share them, and restore from previous states.

Try an example

符合您想法的聊天

单击任何回复下方的 +，将您的对话引向新的方向。
